$notes.about: The fixed-step clock. Simulation runs at stepsPerSecond; rendering interpolates between steps.
$notes.maxStepsPerFrame: when a frame falls behind, run at most this many steps, then drop the rest of the backlog
$notes.maxFrameDelta: seconds; longer frames (tab switches) are clamped to this
$notes.hitStop: a split-second freeze on big hits: sim time runs at timeScale for seconds
$notes.physics: Rapier world: gravity (m/s²), solver iterations per step, and whether loose debris collides with other debris (off on phones to save CPU)
